plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 4th house brings affection into home, privacy, and emotional roots. They may feel comforting or aesthetically right in your inner world. Watch the urge to make a home out of chemistry before trust has had time to prove itself.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
